title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERATV - VehicleTypeAuthorisationCase
description:
Vehicle Type Authorisation Case (era:VehicleTypeAuthorisationCase's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): The process, as selected by the Applicant in line with (EU)2018/545, allowing the vehicle type authorisation and/or the vehicle authorisation for placing on the market.
The type of authorisation cases are described in Art. 14 of (EU)2018/545, and for authorisations before the Fourth Railway Package, a HistoricalAuthorisationCase must be used.

Each authorisation case supports a VehicleTypeAuthorisationApplication and is determined by exactly one VehicleType, and a set of Vehicles, which can be empty in some cases.

For authorisations before the (EU)2018/545 legislation, use `era:VehicleAuthorisationCase. Inherits attributes from era:Case (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VehicleTypeAuthorisationCase'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

areaOfUse.description: Property. (32) ‘area of use of a vehicle’ means a network or networks within a Member State or a group of Member States in which a vehicle is intended to be used; Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

authorisingMemberState.description: Property. Indicates the member state where a vehicle type has been authorized. Not to be confused with Area Of Use. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

certificate.description:
Relationship. For this Vehicle Type (and its underlying authorisation cases),
- the type or design examination certificate (`era:CertificationLevelDocument`) described in the relevant verification module as issued by Notified Bodies, supporting the EC Declaration(s) of Verification for the subsystems in scope of the type's authorisation by an authorizing entity.
- a National certificate reference (`vpa:EvidenceDocument`)

Use only if no link can be made with the underlying authorisation and its presented certificates. Target type (EvidenceDocument) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

configDependentCompliance.description: Relationship. This property is used to link a vehicle type with its conformity checks, through the authorisation case(s) Target type (Compliance) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

configDependentCondition.description: Relationship. This property is used to link a vehicle type with its restrictions, through the authorisation case(s) Target type (Compliance) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

safetyDeclaration.description: Property. Reference to the written declaration by the proposer referred to in Article 3(11) of Regulation (EU) No 402/2013

typeRegistrationMethod.description: Property. The registration method which was used in the vehicle type authorisation process. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Vehicle Type Registration Methods' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/vehicle-type-registration-methods/VehicleTypeRegistrationMethods), 12 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

concerns.description: Relationship. holds as material content, constitutes, embodies the material components of the Scope. Target type (Scope) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

constitutes.description: Relationship. forms a complete, independent, possibly sole part of a request Target type (Request) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

permissionType.description: Property. the detailed process which constitutes this Case's permission conditions Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

status.description: Property. the status of the Request, or constituting Case(s), as it is being treated by the PermittingBody Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.
